comment: Shared policy for every class-unlock NPC: direct Normal duels only while this character's final quest is incomplete. Turning in that quest unlocks the NPC in the account's faction-specific random roster, with the same deck and Normal / Hard AI. duel_complete is the chat line after a credited win (the module prefixes 'Hearthstone: '); victory_lines are one or two lines the NPC says to the winner. Add future class NPCs here, then run python tools/decks/gen_deck_library.py to regenerate the roster SQL and C++ bindings.
